subject.title: [Feature]: Control UI context menus need single-key keyboard shortcuts

question: Should Control UI context menus adopt fixed Latin single-key accelerators while the menu is open?
rationale: The implementation would be small and aligned with web-frontend ergonomics, but it is still a protected UX/product choice and overlaps broader shortcut direction.

options.title: Accept Menu-Scoped Accelerators
options.body: Implement the requested fixed-letter hints and menu-open key handling in the existing session and native-link menu components only.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Shortcut Design
options.body: Keep this issue open but coordinate it with the broader Control UI shortcut trackers before adding one-off menu behavior.

options.title: Defer Single-Key Menu Actions
options.body: Keep the current click/Escape menu behavior if maintainers do not want fixed Latin accelerators or additional shortcut hints yet.

recommendation.title: Accept Menu-Scoped Accelerators
recommendation.body: Implement the requested fixed-letter hints and menu-open key handling in the existing session and native-link menu components only.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the recent merged history for both affected menu surfaces and opened this focused UX request.
